subtitle.en: Feed a bearing. Seat it in a carrier. Advance the line.
subtitle.zh: 供给轴承、放入壳体、推进产线。

description.en: An assembly app for manufacturers building small wheel modules. An indexed conveyor presents a housing; the arm takes a bearing from the feeder, lowers it into the locating pocket and releases it. Completed modules leave the cell on the belt. A different production task, using the same NervusOS motion interface.
description.zh: 面向小型轮组制造商的装配应用。步进输送线送来壳体，机械臂从供料盘取出轴承，下降到定位孔中并松开。装配完成的模块随后沿输送线离开工位。它执行另一种产线任务，使用同一个 NervusOS 运动接口。

label.en: Locate parts using the simulated wrist camera
label.zh: 通过模拟腕部摄像头定位零件

origin.en: Simulated locating and bearing placement, without a press-fit force model. Demo licence runs on PiPER and Panda; no real transaction.
origin.zh: 模拟定位和轴承放置，没有压装力模型。演示许可同时适用于 PiPER 与 Panda，不产生实际交易。

description.en: Load each housing with a bearing and send it down the line.
description.zh: 逐件向壳体放入轴承，再沿产线送出。

description.en: Generate another production order and repeat the process.
description.zh: 生成另一份生产订单，再次执行装配流程。
